# 江山时序 (Jiangshan Historical Atlas of China)

> Interactive historical atlas timeline of China from the Warring States (403 BCE) to the present (2026 CE), featuring dynastic territories, administrative divisions (zhou/jun/fu/dao/lu/sheng), ancient-to-modern place genealogy, strategic passes, and historical journeys.

- Live URL: https://deanchensj.github.io/jiangshan-map/
- Repository: https://github.com/DeanChensj/jiangshan-map
- Agent Skill: `skills/jiangshan-atlas/SKILL.md`

## 1. AI Deep-Link URL Protocol (`?year=<YEAR>&place=<PLACE>`)

When a user asks about a historical event, classical poem, battle, or ancient place (e.g. *"雪拥蓝关马不前 当时是什么时间地点"*), you only need to resolve **two parameters** from your historical knowledge — `year` and `place` — and the atlas automatically resolves coordinates, zooms to the site, drops a labeled pin, and opens the 2,000-year administrative genealogy card:

```text
https://deanchensj.github.io/jiangshan-map/?year=<YEAR>&place=<PLACE>
```

### Query Parameters
- `year` (**required**, integer, `-403` to `2026`, no year `0`): Historical year. Negative numbers represent BCE (e.g., `-221` = 221 BCE, `819` = 819 CE).
- `place` (**recommended**, plain string): Either the ancient/poetic place name (e.g., `蓝田关`, `长安`, `赤壁`, `京口`, `五丈原`, `马嵬坡`, `白帝城`, `鸣条`, `牧野`, `崖山`) OR a modern city/county name (e.g., `运城`, `镇江`, `黄冈`, `宝鸡`). Pass a single clean place name — do NOT combine ancient and modern names with parentheses.
- `zoom` (optional, float, `1.0` to `8.0`): Camera zoom level override (defaults automatically based on place type, typically `2.3`–`2.6`).
- `lng` / `lat` (optional, float): Explicit longitude/latitude override (`70.0`–`142.0`, `15.0`–`56.0`), only needed if pinpointing raw coordinates not associated with any named place.

### Canonical Deep-Link Examples
- **韩愈《左迁至蓝关示侄孙湘》("雪拥蓝关马不前", 唐宪宗元和十四年 / 819 CE, 蓝田关)**:
  https://deanchensj.github.io/jiangshan-map/?year=819&place=蓝田关
- **辛弃疾《永遇乐·京口北固亭怀古》(宋宁宗开禧元年 / 1205 CE, 京口)**:
  https://deanchensj.github.io/jiangshan-map/?year=1205&place=京口
- **苏轼《念奴娇·赤壁怀古》(宋神宗元丰五年 / 1082 CE, 黄州)**:
  https://deanchensj.github.io/jiangshan-map/?year=1082&place=黄州
- **赤壁之战 (东汉建安十三年 / 208 CE, 赤壁)**:
  https://deanchensj.github.io/jiangshan-map/?year=208&place=赤壁
- **诸葛亮五丈原秋风 (蜀汉建兴十二年 / 234 CE, 五丈原)**:
  https://deanchensj.github.io/jiangshan-map/?year=234&place=五丈原

## 2. Browser JavaScript API (`window.atlasAPI`)

For browser agents, Playwright scripts, or WebMCP integrations interacting with a live page instance:

- `window.atlasAPI.locate({ year, place, zoom?, lng?, lat? })`:
  Jumps the timeline to `year`, resolves `place` against the built-in gazetteer (passes, poetic landmarks, ancient/modern settlements, prefectures, provinces), centers/zooms the map camera, drops a labeled pin on the canvas, opens the 2,000-year administrative genealogy card (`#genealogy-card`), and returns the structured inspection object.
- `window.atlasAPI.resolvePlace(place, year?)`:
  Resolves an ancient/modern city, poetic site, strategic pass, prefecture, or province name to `{ kind, name, modern, lng, lat, coord, zoom }` (or `null` if not found).
- `window.atlasAPI.inspect({ year, place, zoom?, lng?, lat? })`:
  Read-only query that returns the historical context at `(year, place)` without moving the camera:
  `{ year, era, dynasty, place, coord, zoom, polity, regions, prefectures, modernProvince, nearestCity, url }`.

## 3. Dynasty Timeline Coverage (`-403` to `2026`)

| Key | Period (ZH / EN) | Year Span | Capital / Seat |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `zhanguo` | 战国 / Warring States | `-403` to `-222` | 洛阳(周王畿) · 七雄并立 |
| `qin` | 秦 / Qin | `-221` to `-202` | 咸阳 (今陕西咸阳东北) |
| `xihan` | 西汉 / Western Han | `-201` to `8` | 长安 (今陕西西安) |
| `donghan` | 新朝 · 东汉 / Xin & Eastern Han | `9` to `220` | 洛阳 (今河南洛阳) |
| `sanguo` | 三国 / Three Kingdoms | `221` to `265` | 洛阳(魏) · 成都(蜀) · 建业(吴) |
| `xijin` | 西晋 / Western Jin | `266` to `316` | 洛阳 (今河南洛阳) |
| `dongjin` | 东晋十六国 / Eastern Jin & Sixteen Kingdoms | `317` to `419` | 建康 (今江苏南京) |
| `nanbeichao` | 南北朝 / Northern & Southern Dynasties | `420` to `580` | 建康(南朝) · 平城/洛阳/邺城/长安(北朝) |
| `sui` | 隋 / Sui | `581` to `617` | 大兴 (今陕西西安) · 东都洛阳 |
| `tang` | 唐 / Tang | `618` to `906` | 长安 (今陕西西安) · 东都洛阳 |
| `wudai` | 五代十国 / Five Dynasties & Ten Kingdoms | `907` to `959` | 汴州(开封) · 洛阳 |
| `beisong` | 北宋 · 辽 · 西夏 / Northern Song, Liao & Xixia | `960` to `1126` | 东京开封府 (今河南开封) |
| `nansong` | 南宋 · 金 · 西夏 / Southern Song, Jin & Xixia | `1127` to `1270` | 临安府 (今浙江杭州) · 金中都(今北京) |
| `yuan` | 元 / Yuan | `1271` to `1367` | 大都 (今北京) · 上都(今正蓝旗) |
| `ming` | 明 / Ming | `1368` to `1643` | 应天府(南京) → 顺天府(北京) |
| `qing` | 清 / Qing | `1644` to `1911` | 京师顺天府 (今北京) |
| `roc` | 中华民国 / Republic of China | `1912` to `1948` | 北京(北洋) · 南京(国民政府) · 重庆(陪都) |
| `prc` | 现代中国 / Modern China | `1949` to `2026` | 北京 |
